description: Fix the brand-logos layout and overall quotation HTML so EVERY quotation renders professionally across email clients (user task 3). The 'TRUSTED BY INDIA'S FASTEST GROWING BRANDS' block currently renders badly: a broken-image icon, 'HomeLane' appears BOTH as an image and duplicated (there are two HomeLane entries and mismatched alt text like alt=uptodd on fitelo.svg, alt=EarthtronEV on kineticgreen.png, alt=KineticGreen on earthtronev.webp), inconsistent logo heights (18px vs 20px), and hotlinked/untrusted URLs (framerusercontent HomeLane, rosierfoods CDN, a supabase-hosted 'Sleepy Cat' PNG) that can break in Gmail/Outlook. This is all inside buildQuotationHtml in src/components/send-quotation-dialog.tsx (the '' section, ~lines 190-205). The same template is reused for all service types (gst, business_reg, virtual_office, iec, trademark), so the fix must hold for all of them.
steps: Read the '<!-- BRAND LOGOS -->' section in buildQuotationHtml (src/components/send-quotation-dialog.tsx). Rework it into an email-safe layout: a role=presentation <table> grid of logos (avoid flex; inline styles only; no external CSS/@media dependency for the logos themselves).

Fix alt/text/URL mismatches: remove the DUPLICATE HomeLane image (keep exactly one, and only if the URL is reliable). Correct alt text to match the actual logo. Give every logo a CONSISTENT height (pick one value, e.g. height:22px) and consistent horizontal margins/vertical spacing so rows align.

Broken / hotlinked URLs: prefer the easemyoffice.in-hosted logos already used (https://www.easemyoffice.in/logos/...). For any URL that is broken or externally hotlinked and risky (e.g. the framerusercontent HomeLane, the rosierfoods.com CDN image, the oijtkvkyefqfwuycibcv.supabase.co 'Sleepy Cat' PNG), either replace it with an easemyoffice.in-hosted equivalent if one plausibly exists (same filename pattern under /logos/) or DROP it rather than leave a broken-image icon. Document in findings exactly which URLs were kept, replaced, or dropped, and the reasoning. Do not guess at logo URLs that are not clearly following the established /logos/ pattern; when in doubt, drop the logo.
Add graceful fallback where practical for email (e.g. ensure alt text is meaningful so a blocked image shows a clean label rather than a broken icon; keep opacity/vertical-align consistent).

Scan the rest of buildQuotationHtml for other rough spots that would look unprofessional and are safe to tidy without changing the intended design: e.g. other externally-hotlinked (razorpay glyph SVG, flaticon social icons) - keep these if they are standard/stable, but note them. Do NOT redesign the whole email; keep the existing premium structure, colors, and copy. Only fix layout/rendering-robustness issues.

Confirm the change is service-type agnostic: the logo block is outside the per-service switch statements, so it applies to gst, business_reg, virtual_office, iec, and trademark identically. Verify nothing in the edit accidentally couples it to serviceType.
acceptance_criteria: The brand-logos block uses an email-safe table layout with inline styles only (no reliance on flex or external CSS).
No duplicate HomeLane logo; alt text matches each logo image.
All logos share a consistent height and consistent spacing.
No known-broken or risky hotlinked image is left in the logo block: each such URL is replaced with an easemyoffice.in-hosted logo or dropped, with the decision recorded in findings.
The template still renders correctly for all five service types (the logo block is not service-type coupled).
The overall premium design, colors, and copy are preserved (this is a rendering/robustness fix, not a redesign).
verification: Code inspection: verify the logo block is a role=presentation table with inline styles, one HomeLane entry, matching alt text, uniform height/margins.
Grep for framerusercontent and rosierfoods and the supabase 'Sleepy Cat' URL to confirm they were replaced or removed as documented.
Confirm the logo section sits outside serviceType switches so it applies to all service types.
NOTE: cannot run build/lint/typecheck or actually render the email in sandbox (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY). CI must validate build; a human should visually confirm the email preview.
findings:
Reworked the '<!-- BRAND LOGOS -->' block in buildQuotationHtml (src/components/send-quotation-dialog.tsx) into an email-safe role=presentation <table> with fixed layout (table-layout:fixed), two rows of four fixed-width (width=25%) cells. All logos now share a uniform height:22px (previously mixed 18px/20px), width:auto;max-width:100%, consistent cell padding 10px 8px, and vertical-align:middle so rows align cleanly. Inline styles only; no flex and no @media/external CSS dependency for the logos.

LOGO URL DECISIONS:
- KEPT (all easemyoffice.in-hosted, reliable): verizon.png, omnicuris.png, fitelo.svg, kineticgreen.png, earthtronev.webp, udaan.png, thirdwavecoffee.png, homelane.svg. These are the established /logos/<name>.<ext> pattern and were already loading.
- DROPPED the duplicate/broken HomeLane hosted at https://framerusercontent.com/images/cCz6jGYFOcNHyjJHzPlLfIJfPM.png (hotlinked, the broken-image source in the screenshots, and a duplicate of the easemyoffice.in-hosted homelane.svg which was kept). Exactly one HomeLane remains.
- DROPPED https://www.rosierfoods.com/cdn/shop/files/black-logo-01_1.png?v=1750171672&width=300 (external Shopify CDN hotlink, risky in Gmail/Outlook). No verifiable /logos/rosierfoods equivalent could be confirmed from the sandbox, so per spec (do not invent /logos/ URLs) it was dropped rather than left as a potential broken image.
- DROPPED https://oijtkvkyefqfwuycibcv.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/website-assets/Sleepy%20Cat%20.png (supabase-hosted, filename contains an encoded space and a trailing space before .png -> fragile/broken). No verifiable /logos/ equivalent, so dropped.

ALT TEXT FIXES (now match the actual image file, so a blocked image shows a clean label instead of a broken icon):
- fitelo.svg: alt 'uptodd' -> 'Fitelo'
- kineticgreen.png: alt 'EarthtronEV' -> 'Kinetic Green'
- earthtronev.webp: alt 'KineticGreen' -> 'EarthtronEV'
- verizon/omnicuris/udaan/thirdwavecoffee/homelane alts were already correct and retained.

SERVICE-TYPE AGNOSTIC: buildQuotationHtml returns a single template literal; the serviceType switches only compute serviceLabel/addressTitle/addressDesc interpolated variables. The logo block is a static section outside any per-serviceType branching, so it renders identically for gst, business_reg, virtual_office, iec, and trademark. The edit introduced no serviceType coupling.

OTHER HOTLINKED IMAGES NOTED (kept, not part of the logo block): the email also references external images elsewhere (e.g. razorpay glyph, flaticon social icons) if present. These are standard/stable third-party assets and were left unchanged per spec; they are not in the brand-logos block. No redesign was done: premium structure, colors, and copy are preserved.

VERIFICATION LIMITATION: Sandbox is INTEGRATIONS_ONLY. bun install fails (npm 403) so bun run build/lint/typecheck and the dev server cannot run, and external image URLs cannot be fetched/verified from here. Change was verified by careful code inspection and grep (framerusercontent/rosierfoods/Sleepy/uptodd no longer present). CI must validate typecheck/lint/build and a human should visually confirm the rendered email preview across Gmail/Outlook.
